I-SPI deployment

Manifests, schema and guides for running I-SPI, an R Shiny application for bead-based immunoassay data, with its curve-fitting tier i-spi-compute.

Documentation: https://immunoplex.github.io/i-spi-deployment/

To Guide
understand what gets deployed Overview
run everything on one machine with Docker On one machine
install on a server you control (K3s or Kubernetes) On your own cluster
install with a cloud provider, including in the EU In the cloud
install without internet access Without internet access
move to a new release Upgrading and rolling back

Current versions: I-SPI 1.1.1, i-spi-compute 1.1.1, calib schema 0.7.0.

What is in this repository

Folder Contents
k8s-manifests/ the Kubernetes manifests, with IMMUNOPLEX_* placeholders
db/ the database schema for a new database, and its manifest
local/ a Docker Compose stack with every service on one machine
tests/ the automated checks run on every pull request
vignettes/articles/ the source of the documentation site
templates/ the web theme for the Dex sign-in pages
